column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the importdag warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Derivation: Every Import Spelling Records One Edge by Path, and an Ambiguous Stem Is Refused
The Names: Every Engine Module Is Named Importably, and a Fresh Interpreter Proves It Without a Path Edit
The Census: A Witness Whose Subprocess Script Out-Runs Its Declared Closure Is Flagged
The Sibling Edge: importdag Resolves mikemol-atomicwrite Beside Its Own Namespace Package
The Closure: A Witness Is Staged Exactly the Engine Cone It Imports, Reads, Resolves and Runs
The Legacy Writer: Stem-Valued Edges Are Derived Flat and Written Atomically Through the Sibling
The DAG File: Path-Valued Edges Are Rendered, Checked and Written Atomically Through the Sibling
The Resolver: A Relative Import Is Looked Up Exactly From Its Level, an Absolute One at Its Longest Dotted Prefix, and an Ambiguous Name Is Reported, Never Picked
The Implicit Package Edge: Importing a Module Also Imports the __init__.py of Every Package Directory the Name Spans
